source: Mixture-of-experts ideas are much older than modern ZXNAME0000XZ. Jacobs, Jordan, Nowlan, and Hinton introduced Adaptive Mixtures of Local Experts in 1991: separate expert networks learned different subsets of training cases while a gating mechanism allocated cases among them.
zh: 混合专家的想法比现代的 ZXNAME0000XZ 更古老。 Jacobs、Jordan、Nowlan 和 Hinton 于 1991 年引入了本地专家的自适应混合：单独的专家网络学习不同的训练案例子集，同时门控机制在它们之间分配案例。
